title: Periodic groove glass boosts high-angle light capture for facade PV
content:
A research team in China has developed a periodic groove glass structure to improve light capture in facade-mounted PV modules.
The proposed design was found to reduce reflection at high incidence angles while maintaining compatibility with large-scale glass manufacturing.

content:
Octopus Energy is developing a 100-home “Zero Bills Homes” neighborhood in France, combining solar PV, heat pumps, batteries, and smart energy management. title: Italian energy communities reach 303 MW of operational capacity
content:
Italy has 3,630 active renewable energy communities with a combined operational capacity of 302.9 MW, according to new data.
More than 29,800 PNRR-funded applications have been approved, unlocking €768.3 million in grants for 1.74 GW of capacity.

Available in power ratings from 3 kW to 6 kW, the system features up to 200% PV oversizing, less then 4 ms seamless switching, and AI-powered energy management functions.

title: Colombia’s PV capacity tops 4.58 GW, with 1.19 GW under testing
content:
Colombia's installed solar capacity has surpassed 4.58 GW, with nearly 1.2 GW of projects still undergoing testing, as solar accounts for more than 98% of renewable capacity added since August 2022. The country needs to add about 1.35 GW more of solar, wind and small-scale hydropower by August 2026 to meet the government's 6 GW renewable energy target.

title: Low-cost catalyst innovation boosts green hydrogen production

title: Return and Engie, EnBW and Zelestra agree long-term BESS tolls in Spain, Italy
content: Return and Engie have agreed a long-term BESS toll in Spain while EnBW and Zelestra have finalised one in Italy, totalling 55MW and 300MW of capacity respectively.

title: India awards long-duration energy storage contracts for 1,344MW pumped hydro, utility-scale flow battery
content: Two big developments for India’s emerging long-duration energy storage (LDES) sector, with contracts awarded for pumped hydro energy storage (PHES) and the country’s first large-scale flow battery.

title: European Energy reaches financial close on 80MWh Mokoan solar-plus-storage site in Australia

title: South Australia’s Lunio Energy brings 20MWh grid-scale battery storage system online
